FN-F2TM5C5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 137
Committee: State Governmental Affairs Sponsor: Senator J.T. 'Jabo' Waggoner
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 02/18/2025
Senate Bill 137 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Public Service Commission
by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to regulate certain private sewer or
wastewater systems that elect to come under the jurisdiction of the commission. These
obligations could be offset, in whole or in part, by the collection of certain existing regulatory
fees.
